sme_loan_pct.yr2023: CAVEAT — not a fiscal-year-end/audited figure, unlike every other cell in this file. The Business Standard, 'By 2024, 25% of loans will be disbursed to CMSME sector' (tbsnews.net, published 2023-07-31), quoting NBL EVP & Divisional Head Md Sahidul Islam: 'at present, 12% of the bank's total loan disbursement portfolio — worth Tk5,350 crore — is in the CMSME sector,' with a stated target of 25% by 2024. Two mismatches with this row: (1) it's a mid-2023 snapshot ('at present', i.e. as of the July 2023 publish date), not a 31-Dec-2023 year-end figure; (2) 'CMSME' is Bangladesh Bank's Cottage+Micro+Small+Medium Enterprise classification, a broader category than 'SME' alone, so this likely overstates a narrower SME-only percentage. No corresponding figure found in the FY2023 Annual Report itself (checked — no segment/loan-mix disclosure) or in any other year's annual report or news coverage, so this can't be corroborated or extended to other years.
